newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Taib to take stake in Kazakh bank.
newsitem.headline: Taib to take stake in Kazakh bank.

text.p: Bahrain-based Taib Bank said on Monday it would take a majority stake in a bank in Kazakhstan.
Chief Executive Officer Iqbal Mamdani said in a statement the bank had obtained permission "to acquire a majority holding" in a bank in Kazakhstan. He did not identify the bank.
The bank is expected to be called Taib Kazak Bank and would be located in Almaty, he said. Operations are expected to start in few months, Mamdani added.
Taib, an investment and merchant bank, on Monday announced record 1996 profits of $10.4 million, up from $9.7 million a year earlier.
